cuhkAdmission.introduction: Paving your university journey with our Professional Accountancy Programme The BBA in Professional Accountancy (PACC) Programme was the first accounting degree programme offered in Hong Kong. Our curriculum is designed to nurture dynamic, well-rounded business professionals who will be in demand in the market long into the future. A remarkable component of the PACC Programme is the vast array of experiential learning opportunities we offer. Internships, exchanges, career workshops, study trips and case competitions are thoughtfully designed to deepen students’ knowledge and understanding of the industry. All PACC graduates are eligible to apply for the Qualification Programme (QP) of the Hong Kong Institute of Certified Public Accountants (HKICPA) and other accounting professional examinations. Our graduates are highly sought-after by recruiters from international accounting firms and other businesses. Unleash your potential with our unique feature – A diverse choice of streams The PACC Programme strives to go above and beyond, offering opportunities for students to specialise in accounting or related fields. The curriculum of the PACC Programme offers students the option to specialise in various streams to shape themselves into future business professionals with a global mindset. The streams we offer include Global Accounting, Global Tax and Governance, Finance for Accountants, and Accounting Analytics.
cuhkAdmission.careerProspects: The PACC Programme opens the door to a huge variety of opportunities and leads to rewarding careers. PACC graduates are ideally suited for careers in accounting firms, banks, finance companies, commercial firms and the public sector. If you are interested in this programme, please review the application requirements and deadlines specific to the respective admission scheme to increase your chances of getting accepted. APPLY NOW

Interview: Yes (selected applicants)

CSD: A

2nd Elective: 4

curriculum.title: Curriculum & Streams
content: The BBA in Professional Accountancy (PACC) is the first accounting degree programme in Hong Kong, designed to nurture dynamic, well-rounded business professionals.
The curriculum offers a diverse choice of streams for specialisation:
- Global Accounting
- Global Tax and Governance
- Finance for Accountants
- Accounting Analytics
Experiential learning is a key component: internships, exchanges, career workshops, study trips, and case competitions.
All PACC graduates are eligible to apply for the HKICPA Qualification Programme (QP) and other professional accounting examinations.
Programme duration: 4 years (full-time).

career.title: Career Prospects
content: PACC graduates are highly sought-after by recruiters from international accounting firms, banks, finance companies, commercial firms, and the public sector.
Typical career paths include:
- Auditor / Tax Consultant / Financial Analyst in Big Four firms
- Corporate accountant in multinational corporations
- Roles in investment banking, consulting, and regulatory bodies
The programme's strong industry connections and accreditation (HKICPA, ACCA, CPA Australia, CIMA) ensure global recognition and career mobility.

campus.title: Campus Life & Facilities
content: CUHK's Shatin campus offers a vibrant learning environment with nine colleges, each providing residential, pastoral, and cultural experiences.
Students have access to state-of-the-art business school facilities, including trading rooms, collaborative spaces, and the CUHK Business School library.
Exchange programmes and internships are integral to the PACC experience, with opportunities at partner universities worldwide and leading accounting firms.
The campus is well-connected by public transport and offers extensive sports, arts, and student organisation activities.

competitiveness.title: Competitiveness & Selection
content: In 2025, JS4240 received 384 Band A applications and made 111 offers, resulting in a Band A offer rate of approximately 28.9%.
Band A applications per offer: ~3.5
Admission is competitive, with median and LQ scores both at 26 (Best 5). The UQ of 54.75 reflects the high achievers admitted.
English is weighted double, so strong English performance is crucial.
Interview performance is considered for selected applicants.

alumni.title: Notable Alumni & Faculty Excellence
content: CUHK's School of Accountancy has produced many leaders in the accounting profession:
- Wong Tin-yau (黃天祐): Former Chairman of HKICPA, current CEO of the Accounting and Financial Reporting Council (AFRC).
- Clement Chan Kam-wing (陳錦榮): Managing Partner of BDO Hong Kong, former President of HKICPA.
- Edward Chow Kwong-fai (周光暉): Former Chairman of the HKEX Listing Committee, senior partner at KPMG.
- Susanna Chiu Lai-kuen (趙麗娟): Former President of HKICPA, partner at PwC.
- Peter Wong Wai-yee (黃偉宜): Former Chairman of HKICPA, partner at Deloitte.
Faculty includes award-winning researchers with strong ties to Big Four firms and professional bodies.

scholarships.title: Scholarships & Financial Aid
content: CUHK offers a range of entrance scholarships for local JUPAS students based on academic merit.
Scholarships may cover full or partial tuition fees, and some include living expenses.
Students can also apply for the Hong Kong Government's Targeted Scholarship and Financial Support (TSFS) and Non-means-tested Loan Scheme (NLSPS).
For details, visit: https://admission.cuhk.edu.hk/fees-financing-your-studies/

tips.title: Ace Sir's JS4240 Strategy — 9 Actionable Tips
content: **1. Target Score: 26 Points (Best 5)**
- Median and LQ both at 26; aim for at least 26 to be competitive.
- Use the subject weightings: English is double-weighted, so a high English grade significantly boosts your score.
**2. Prioritise English and Mathematics**
- English is weighted x2; a Level 5 or above is ideal.
- Mathematics (Compulsory) at Level 5* or above strengthens your profile.
**3. Choose Electives Strategically**
- Two electives at Level 3 or above; M1/M2 can count as one elective.
- Consider Business, Economics, or Accounting-related subjects if available.
**4. Prepare for the Interview**
- Interview is required for selected applicants; practice common accounting and business ethics questions.
- Demonstrate motivation, analytical thinking, and knowledge of the profession.
**5. Highlight Your CSD Attained Grade**
- CSD must be 'Attained' (A); this is a minimum requirement, not a differentiator.
**6. Leverage Applied Learning (ApL) Subjects**
- ApL subjects with 'Attained with Distinction I/II' can earn bonus points as an extra elective.
**7. Apply for Band A in JUPAS**
- Band A applicants have the highest chance; in 2025, all offers went to Band A.
**8. Research the Streams**
- Familiarise yourself with the four streams (Global Accounting, Global Tax and Governance, Finance for Accountants, Accounting Analytics) to discuss in interview.
**9. Visit the Programme Website**
- Explore https://pacc.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk/ for detailed curriculum, faculty, and student resources.

curriculum.title: 課程結構及專修範疇
content: 專業會計學工商管理學士（PACC）是香港首個會計學位課程，旨在培育具備環球視野的商業專才。
課程提供多個專修範疇（Streams）供學生選擇：
- 環球會計
- 環球稅務與治理
- 會計金融
- 會計分析
體驗式學習是課程重點：實習、交流、職業工作坊、考察團及個案比賽。
所有 PACC 畢業生均符合資格報考香港會計師公會（HKICPA）專業資格課程（QP）及其他專業會計考試。
修讀年期：4 年（全日制）。

career.title: 就業前景
content: PACC 畢業生深受國際會計師事務所、銀行、金融機構、商業機構及公營機構僱主歡迎。
典型職業路徑包括：
- 四大會計師事務所核數師/稅務顧問/財務分析師
- 跨國企業會計師
- 投資銀行、顧問及監管機構職位
課程的強大行業網絡及專業認證（HKICPA、ACCA、CPA Australia、CIMA）確保畢業生具備國際認可及職業流動性。

campus.title: 校園生活及設施
content: 香港中文大學沙田校園提供充滿活力的學習環境，設有九所書院，提供住宿、關顧及文化體驗。
學生可使用商學院先進設施，包括交易室、協作空間及商學院圖書館。
交流計劃及實習是 PACC 課程的重要部分，學生可前往全球合作院校及頂尖會計師事務所。
校園交通便利，並提供豐富的體育、藝術及學生組織活動。

competitiveness.title: 競爭力及甄選
content: 2025 年，JS4240 收到 384 份 Band A 申請，發出 111 個取錄，Band A 取錄率約 28.9%。
每 Band A 取錄對應申請人數：約 3.5 人
入學競爭激烈，中位數及下四分位數均為 26 分（最佳五科）。上四分位數 54.75 反映高分考生。
英文科比重雙計，英文成績優異至關重要。
面試表現會影響選定申請人的取錄結果。

alumni.title: 著名校友及學院成就
content: 香港中文大學會計學院培育眾多會計專業領袖：
- 黃天祐：前香港會計師公會會長，現任會計及財務匯報局（AFRC）行政總裁。
- 陳錦榮：BDO 香港董事總經理，前香港會計師公會會長。
- 周光暉：前香港交易所上市委員會主席，KPMG 資深合夥人。
- 趙麗娟：前香港會計師公會會長，PricewaterhouseCoopers 合夥人。
- 黃偉宜：前香港會計師公會會長，Deloitte 合夥人。
學院教授屢獲研究獎項，與四大會計師事務所及專業機構聯繫緊密。

scholarships.title: 獎學金及資助
content: 香港中文大學為本地 JUPAS 學生提供多項入學獎學金，根據學業成績頒發。
獎學金可涵蓋全額或部分學費，部分包括生活費。
學生亦可申請香港政府的「專上學生資助計劃」（TSFS）及「免入息審查貸款計劃」（NLSPS）。
詳情請瀏覽：https://admission.cuhk.edu.hk/fees-financing-your-studies/

tips.title: Ace Sir 的 JS4240 策略 — 9 個實用貼士
content: **1. 目標分數：26 分（最佳五科）**
- 中位數及下四分位數均為 26 分；目標至少 26 分以具競爭力。
- 善用科目比重：英文科雙計，英文成績高可大幅提升分數。
**2. 優先提升英文及數學**
- 英文科比重 x2，理想成績為 5 級或以上。
- 數學（必修部分）達 5* 或以上可增強優勢。
**3. 策略性選擇選修科**
- 兩科選修需達 3 級或以上；M1/M2 可視為一科選修。
- 如學校提供，可選修商業、經濟或會計相關科目。
**4. 準備面試**
- 面試為選定申請人必須環節；練習常見會計及商業倫理問題。
- 展示動機、分析能力及對專業的認識。
**5. 確保公民科達標**
- 公民科必須「達標」（A），此為最低要求，非區分因素。
**6. 善用應用學習科目（ApL）**
- ApL 科目取得「達標並表現優異 I/II」可作為額外選修科獲取加分。
**7. 將 JS4240 放在 Band A**
- Band A 申請人機會最高；2025 年所有取錄均來自 Band A。
**8. 了解四個專修範疇**
- 熟悉環球會計、環球稅務與治理、會計金融、會計分析四個範疇，以便面試時討論。
**9. 瀏覽課程網站**
- 到訪 https://pacc.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk/ 查閱詳細課程、教授及學生資源。
